name: The Solitary Existence of a Little Universe
detailed_description:
A DARK INTERACTIVE NOVEL WITH OBSCURE CHOICES.

The Solitary Existence of a Little Universe is an existential short story that will take players to explore mysterious places and confront them with choices that will affect not only the events of the story, but also the relationship with the faithful companion who will accompany you on your journey.

The places you will explore are ruins of a dying reality. No one will tell you what to do or what to observe, it will be up to you to decide whether to go straight to your goal or explore your surroundings.

Similarly, the consequences of your choices will never be obvious and very often mark the loss of something you will never know about. But is this not the condition of our very own existence?

A CRESTFALLEN SOUL IN A LONELY DESERT.

You impersonate a lost one, thrown into a world he does not understand. With a obscure past and unable to die, he drags himself mindlessly through the barren wilderness with no purpose other than the hope to find eternal oblivion.

Until he is found by... Her...

She seems to be the key to finally achieving his final rest, but to do so he needs to cross this forsaken world with her. What will they find on their lonely pilgrimage?

short_description: In this dark interactive novel you will play as a lost soul wandering a forsaken desert, accompanied by a mysterious girl. Explore ancient ruins and face obscure choices. Your decisions will shape their journey—often in ways you’ll never fully understand. Will you find peace, or something else?
